descriptions.text: Enchanted Wrestling Belt of the Great Gorgo. While you'll never be as amazing as the greatest, most beautiful wrestler of all time—Christopher Alan Pallies—you will look pretty snazzy when you wrap this bad boy around your waist. This enchanted belt offers the following benefits: +5% Strength +5% Constitution +The Avalanche benefit.

beats.headline: Platinum Slam Master
beats.text: After the bounty, Katia's boxes bring a Find Crawler skill potion and half a million gold, and one more: a Platinum Slam Master box, for killing a certain number of mobs with her momentum. Out comes a gold wrestling belt like any heavyweight champion's. Who is Christopher Pallies, she asks; Carl does not know. Five percent strength, five percent constitution, and the Avalanche benefit: hit a living creature with her body while all of it is moving, and the force is as if they were hit by twice the mass. It does not carry to weapons. We need to stick you to the front of another train, Carl says. He does not say aloud that her Rush just got stronger too.

beats.headline: Like a monster truck
beats.text: Katia's new riot shield upgrades her Rush to Crowd Blast. It is still the battering ram she killed Hekla with, but now everything in a wide cone ahead of her takes ten to twenty percent of the damage. With her wrestling belt bonus on top, Carl reckons, it would be the equivalent of hitting someone with a monster truck. More important, she can now use it every five minutes instead of once a day.

relations.note: Its Crowd Blast plus the belt's Avalanche
